overview: The Council approved support for Tufts Resident Assistants and referred a ban on black plastic takeout containers to committee. Members also authorized funding for fire gear and school repairs while significantly cutting a supplemental appropriation for the Law Department pending an independent audit.

items.title: Sanctuary UCC Closure Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution honoring the 154-year history and community impact of the Congregational Church of West Medford Sanctuary United Church of Christ upon its closure.

items.title: Records and Reports of Committees
items.summary: Approved meeting records from October 13th and reports from the Resident Services and Committee of the Whole meetings.

items.title: Employee Vacation Time Cost Analysis
items.summary: Referred a request for a cost analysis of increasing city employee vacation time to the Administration and Finance Committee for consideration in the next budget cycle.

items.title: Support for Tufts Resident Assistants Union
items.summary: Approved a resolution supporting the United Labor of Tufts Resident Assistants in their contract negotiations and opposing proposed cuts to their housing and meal compensation.

items.title: Black Plastic Takeout Container Ban
items.summary: Referred a proposal to develop an ordinance banning black plastic takeout containers to the Energy and Environment and Public Health committees for drafting.

items.title: Veterans Department Vacancy Update
items.summary: Requested a formal update and interim staffing plan from the administration regarding the vacancy in the Veterans Department and the temporary closure of its office.

items.title: Comcast Grant of Location: 75 Riverside Avenue
items.summary: Approved a grant of location for Comcast to install approximately 273 feet of underground conduit and new manhole structures to service 75 Riverside Avenue.

items.title: Pavement Coffee House Common Victualler's License
items.summary: Approved a Common Victualler's license for Pavement Coffee House to operate at 177 College Avenue on the Tufts University campus.

items.title: Linkage Fee Ordinance Update
items.summary: Referred a zoning ordinance update to the Community Development Board to incorporate automatic annual increases and establish specific fee amounts for affordable housing linkage.

items.title: Personal Injury Legal Settlements
items.summary: Approved two $5,000 settlements for personal injury claims resulting from slips and falls on defective city sidewalks.

items.title: Fire Gear and Soil Remediation Appropriations
items.summary: Approved $445,470 for new firefighter turnout gear and $200,000 for ongoing soil remediation and regulatory reporting at 448 High Street.

items.title: School Accelerated Repair Project Reappropriation
items.summary: Approved the transfer of $57,870 between school repair funds to cover a deficit in the Brooks Elementary feasibility study.

items.title: City Charter Implementation and Legal Counsel Memo
items.summary: Discussed a legal opinion regarding charter codification and renewed requests for the administration to meet with the Council and School Committee to finalize an implementation plan.

items.title: Disposition of McCormick Avenue Parcels
items.summary: Referred an order to declare two city-owned lots on McCormick Avenue as surplus to the Committee of the Whole for a comprehensive review of all vacant municipal parcels.

items.title: MWRA Combined Sewer Overflow Comment Letter
items.summary: Approved a comment letter to the MWRA requesting a long-term control plan that results in zero sewage discharge into the Mystic River, despite concerns regarding the high cost of such a mandate.

items.title: Police Chief Search Tabled
items.summary: Tabled a funding request for the police chief search because no representative from the administration was present to provide an update.

items.title: Law Department Supplemental Appropriation
items.summary: Voted to cut the requested appropriation by nearly $300,000, funding only one month of administrative salary while demanding the administration initiate a previously agreed-upon independent legal audit.

items.title: Appointments and Public Participation
items.summary: Approved several board and commission appointments and heard final general comments from the public before adjournment.
